entries.title: Cataclismo

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Cataclismo left Early Access on Steam on March 20, 2025. It is a Windows real-time strategy/tower-defense/base-building release from Digital Sun and Hooded Horse, with Workshop support, a full single-player campaign, skirmish, challenge mode, and a map editor. No console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is both the complete route and the best archive capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam 1.0 release. Capture campaign, skirmish, challenge mode, and any Workshop/map-editor material as separate archive notes.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with full 1.0 content, Workshop support, and the strongest capture/settings path.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched 1.0 build.
